from harness import *

fails = 0
def one(wire, peer='edge', auth='alice', egress='internal', t=0, wire_hex=None):
    out = run(envelope([ev(t, peer=peer, auth=auth, egress=egress, wire=wire, wire_hex=wire_hex)]))
    r = out['results'][0]
    return r

def C(desc, wire, expected, **kw):
    global fails
    r = one(wire, **kw)
    got = r['reason'] if r['decision'] == 'reject' else 'OK'
    if got != expected:
        fails += 1; print('FAIL %-38s expected %-10s got %-10s %s' % (desc, expected, got, r))
    return r

HDRS = ['From: %s', 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c1', 'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length: 0']
def raw(*lines, body=b''):
    return ('\r\n'.join(lines) + '\r\n\r\n').encode('latin-1') + body

S = 'MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0'

# folding
C('fold in From', raw(S, 'From: sip:alice@lab.test', ' ;tag=t1', 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c1', 'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length: 0'), 'OK')
C('fold in middle of value', raw(S, 'From: sip:alice@', '   lab.test;tag=t1', 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c1', 'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length: 0'), 'fields')
C('fold joins with single space', raw(S, 'From: "A"', '     ', '  <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t1', 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c1', 'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length: 0'), 'OK')
C('fold empty continuation', raw(S, 'From: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t1', 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c1', 'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length: 0', 'X: a', '  '), 'OK')
C('fold on CL', raw(S, 'From: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t1', 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c1', 'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length: 0', ' 0'), 'length')
C('name with tab before colon', raw(S, 'From\t: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t1', 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c1', 'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length: 0'), 'OK')
C('name with space inside', raw(S, 'Fr om: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t1', 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c1', 'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length: 0'), 'syntax')
C('no space after colon', raw(S, 'From:sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t1', 'To:<sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID:c1', 'CSeq:1 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length:0'), 'OK')
C('empty unknown value', raw(S, *HDRS[:1], 'X-Empty:', *HDRS[1:]), 'OK') if False else None
C('empty unknown value', raw(S, 'From: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t1', 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c1', 'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length: 0', 'X-Empty:'), 'OK')

# body handling
C('body with crlfcrlf', raw(S, *([h % 'sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t1' if h == 'From: %s' else h for h in HDRS]), body=b'a\r\n\r\nFrom: evil'), 'length')
w = raw(S, 'From: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t1', 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c1', 'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length: 13', body=b'a\r\n\r\nFrom: evil')
r = C('body with crlfcrlf ok', w, 'OK')
C('body NUL', raw(S, 'From: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t1', 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c1', 'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length: 3', body=b'a\x00b'), 'OK')
C('body utf8', raw(S, 'From: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t1', 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c1', 'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length: 2', body='é'.encode()), 'OK')

# header-block byte rules
C('HTAB in value ok', raw(S, 'From: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t1', 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c1', 'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length: 0', 'X: a\tb'), 'OK')
C('LF only in body ok', raw(S, 'From: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t1', 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c1', 'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length: 1', body=b'\n'), 'OK')

# display names
def fromhdr(v):
    return raw(S, 'From: ' + v, 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c1', 'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length: 0')
C('dn quoted escaped quote', fromhdr('"a\\"b" <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t'), 'OK')
C('dn quoted escaped backslash', fromhdr('"a\\\\b" <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t'), 'OK')
C('dn quoted escaped tab', fromhdr('"a\\\tb" <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t'), 'OK')
C('dn quoted escaped space bad', fromhdr('"a\\ b" <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t'), 'fields')
C('dn quoted trailing backslash', fromhdr('"a\\" <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t'), 'fields')
C('dn unquoted multi token', fromhdr('Alice B C <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t'), 'OK')
C('dn unquoted tab sep', fromhdr('Alice\tB <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t'), 'OK')
C('dn unquoted with dot', fromhdr('A.B <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t'), 'OK')
C('dn junk after quote', fromhdr('"A"x <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t'), 'fields')
C('dn comment', fromhdr('(x) <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t'), 'fields')
C('nested brackets', fromhdr('<<sip:alice@lab.test>>;tag=t'), 'fields')
C('bare uri', fromhdr('sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t'), 'OK')
C('bare tel', fromhdr('tel:+12025550100;tag=t'), 'OK')
C('brackets no dn', fromhdr('<sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t'), 'OK')
C('space inside brackets', fromhdr('<sip:alice@lab.test >;tag=t'), 'fields')
C('trailing junk', fromhdr('<sip:alice@lab.test> x;tag=t'), 'fields')

# To / target equality subtleties
def tgt(target, to):
    return raw('MESSAGE %s SIP/2.0' % target, 'From: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t1', 'To: ' + to,
               'Call-ID: c1', 'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length: 0')
C('target port vs to noport', tgt('sip:bob@lab.test:5060', '<sip:bob@lab.test>'), 'fields')
C('target port match', tgt('sip:bob@lab.test:5060', '<sip:bob@lab.test:5060>'), 'OK')
C('target port leading zero', tgt('sip:bob@lab.test:05060', '<sip:bob@lab.test:5060>'), 'OK')
C('sips target', tgt('sips:bob@lab.test', '<sips:bob@lab.test>'), 'OK')
C('sip vs sips', tgt('sips:bob@lab.test', '<sip:bob@lab.test>'), 'fields')
C('target escaped host', tgt('SIP:bob@LAB.TEST', '<sip:bob@lab.test>'), 'OK')
C('target percent user', tgt('sip:%62ob@lab.test', '<sip:bob@lab.test>'), 'OK')

# CSeq
def cseq(v):
    return raw(S, 'From: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t1', 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c1',
               'CSeq: ' + v, 'Content-Length: 0')
C('cseq spaces', cseq('1   MESSAGE'), 'OK')
C('cseq tabs', cseq('1\t\tMESSAGE'), 'OK')
C('cseq space before method only', cseq(' 1 MESSAGE'), 'OK')
C('cseq lower method', cseq('1 message'), 'fields')
print('wire fails:', fails)
PYEOF
